title: Access your myGov account
summary: Learn how to access and use your myGov account to link and manage various Australian Government services online.
intro:
myGov is the Australian Government's secure online portal that allows you to access its services online. myGov is run by Services Australia.

You can choose which services you want to link to your myGov account. It also has a secure inbox where you can get messages from some of your linked services.

### MyServiceNSW Account

To access Service NSW services (such as vehicle registration, driver licence or Working with Children Check), go to the MyServiceNSW Account login.

For more information see the MyServiceNSW Account help topics.
what_you_need: A myGov account to link services to your account.
You can use myGovID to prove your identity when creating an account.
You can sign in using the myGov website or the myGov app.

how_to_steps.text: You will need to create a myGov account to link services to your account.
When you create an account, you'll have the option to use myGovID to prove your identity.
To access your account, you can sign in using the myGov website or the myGov app.

faqs.a: myGov is the Australian Government's secure online portal that allows you to access its services online. It is run by Services Australia.

faqs.q: How do I access Service NSW services?
faqs.a: To access Service NSW services (such as vehicle registration, driver licence or Working with Children Check), go to the MyServiceNSW Account login.

faqs.q: What services can I link to my myGov account?
faqs.a: You can link services such as Medicare, Centrelink, Australian Taxation Office, National Disability Insurance Scheme, Child Support, My Health Record, My Aged Care, and Veterans' Affairs.
